body.message:
I understand, perfect. Would it be possible for you to make it 9,000 AED in total, with 7,000 AED for the rent + 2,000 AED refundable deposit?

Could you do that for me, please? We are only two people, me and my friend. We are currently working here and things are not very easy for us at the moment.

I would like to know if it would be possible to offer us a promotional price to help us out.
